comment.body: This has the same v0.102.3001 New Key pairing error as issue #51893, whose diagnostic archive records Settings IPC rejections for `untrusted-signature`. PR #51789 has since merged a signer-verification fix, but that does not prove your installed build includes it. Please link this report with #51893 and #51914 so the current reproduction evidence stays together. If the error persists on a build containing #51789, add a `/bugreport` captured immediately after selecting **New Key**; that will distinguish the same signer rejection from a separate settings-file failure.
